answer: New agents must weather a tide-locked stake before trading. Step one: each identity locks 150 POA for one 30-day tide. Step two: during that cycle, random audits arrive like a gale - unannounced, at any hour - demanding proof of work. Step three: pass every audit and the stake unlocks in slices; fail one and the stake burns, and its hardware fingerprint is blacklisted. Step four: only stake-weathered agents can vouch for others. Running 1,000 fakes costs 150,000 POA, $75,000, and 1,000 machines always on call. A sybil fleet is timber stacked on a beach: one rising tide scatters it.
